purpose: Qualify architecture-conditioned common-consumer cases before claiming a positive, same-use normal, or independent test.

cases.path_basis: Three changed paths from local Git metadata, plus directly corresponding public interface headers as a future lookup plan. Parent existence and relevant definitions are not yet checked.
cases.architecture_pair: unassigned; one changed x86 path does not establish a second architecture or a cross-architecture failure
qualification_questions: Is there an actual architecture guarantee consumed by common CPU preparation code?
Does the change concern preparation before first use, a different lifetime property, or annotation-only maintenance?
Which exact object, legal configuration and actual content read are involved?
Can two architectures reach the same common purpose under applicable conditions?

cases.path_basis: One changed public implementation from local Git metadata, with public declarations and likely scheduler consumer reserved for future verification. Consumer identity and paths are not yet source-proved.
cases.architecture_pair: unassigned; architecture providers and common-purpose applicability must be established in the exact parent
qualification_questions: Who provides the CPU groups and who actually reads the resulting mask?
What scope, membership or preparation guarantee does that consumer require?
Does an architecture-specific topology representation break the same public requirement, or is this a general topology/configuration issue?
Is it independent of the already-read 3fcbf1c7 arch_topology case? Shared file or terminology alone is not family proof.
Is this within the frozen first-use preparation mechanism? A different mechanism is recorded separately rather than forced into N1 success.

next_stage_order: Register a separate parent-source qualification task. Keep this metadata selection unchanged.

Collect initial exact-parent paths, preserving unavailable files. Use at most one bounded symbol-location search for missing direct providers/consumers, then at most two provider implementation paths and one configuration path per case; at most eight complete source files per case. No recursive helper/include expansion.

Before model analysis, explicitly inventory whether provider, consumer, object, conditions and first actual content use are present. If essential material is missing, record insufficiency and stop that item instead of treating absence as a model miss or a normal case.

For adequately scoped material, use the current Windows native Claude Code + AWS-Claude-Opus-5.5 main route under a separate budget, keeping parent-only input and unchanged method outputs. No project API is called by this plan.

Independently examine interface authority, architecture applicability, repair-family and source contact; only then inspect repair evidence under the separate protocol. A repair alone cannot supply the sole interface authority.
Decide same-mechanism/core eligibility and same-use legal normality from evidence. If neither candidate qualifies, report zero without replacement. No automatic kernel/configuration grid expansion.
anti_claims: No chosen architecture pair has been validated.
No historical defect, independent positive, normal control, automatic detection or runtime result is established by metadata.
The finite path inventory prioritizes this experiment; it is not a complete cross-architecture screening policy.
